scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street view of a large white building with many windows and a clock tower, surrounded by other buildings and people walking around. The sky is blue with some clouds. There are two trash cans in front of the building and a few people standing around. A man and woman are looking at their phones near the trash cans. There are several cars parked along the street and a bus driving down the road. The ground is made of gray bricks and there are some plants and trees along the sidewalk. The overall atmosphere is busy and lively.
scene_analysis.buildings: The large white building has a mix of modern and traditional architecture. It has a flat roof and a clock tower on top. The building is made of white stone and has many windows. There are several balconies and a large entranceway. The building is surrounded by other buildings, including a tall skyscraper in the distance. The building is well-maintained and clean.

scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several benches and tables outside the building, as well as a few chairs and umbrellas. The benches are made of wood and have a simple design. The tables are metal and have a sleek, modern look. The umbrellas are black and provide shade for people sitting outside.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are a few small trees and bushes along the sidewalk, but they are sparse and not very dense. The trees are small and have a few leaves. There are also some flowers and shrubs along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted on the building, including a large sign that reads 'Casa de la Vella' in bold letters. There are also smaller signs that appear to be advertisements or informational signs.
scene_analysis.pedestrian_activity: There are several people walking along the sidewalk, some of whom are carrying bags or backpacks. Some people are sitting on benches or standing and chatting. There are also a few people riding bicycles or scooters.
scene_analysis.lighting_atmosphere: The lighting in the area is bright and sunny, with a few shadows cast by the buildings and trees. The sky is clear and blue, with only a few wispy clouds.
